categories.main_business_segments: GenScript operates three primary business platforms: (i) life-science services and products platform offering gene synthesis, oligonucleotide synthesis, peptide synthesis, protein production, antibody development, and life-science equipment and consumables; (ii) ProBio, a biologics contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO) providing end-to-end biologics development and manufacturing services; and (iii) Bestzyme, an industrial synthetic biology products platform developing enzymes and proteins for feed, food, grain processing, and home care industries. The Group also holds significant investments in Legend Biotech, a cell therapy company.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The Group leverages proprietary gene synthesis technology and advanced protein engineering. ProBio integrates discovery, development, and manufacturing services for biologics, including viral vectors, DNA, RNA, antibodies, and proteins. Bestzyme utilizes synthetic biology, gene editing, large-scale industrial fermentation, and metabolic engineering to develop industrial enzymes and functional proteins. The Group emphasizes automation, lean management, AI-assisted drug discovery, and cGMP manufacturing practices.
categories.primary_customers_markets: GenScript serves global research communities including pharmaceutical, biotech companies, academic institutions, and government bodies. The life-science segment targets early-stage research and discovery projects. ProBio serves biopharma and biotech partners developing therapeutic antibodies and gene/cell therapies. Bestzyme's products cater to industrial users in feed, food, grain processing, and home care sectors. The Group's sales are diversified across the U.S., Mainland China, Europe, Asia Pacific, and other regions.
categories.geographic_coverage: The Group operates in over 100 countries with legal entities in Mainland China, the United States, Hong Kong, Japan, Singapore, Netherlands, United Kingdom, Korea, Spain, Australia, and Macao. Revenue distribution for 2024 was approximately 44.6% from the U.S., 29.8% from Mainland China, 13.6% from Europe, 8.9% from Asia Pacific excluding Mainland China, and 3.1% from other regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: GenScript operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the biotechnology supply chain. It provides research services, product synthesis, biologics development, and manufacturing services, as well as industrial enzyme production. The Group also engages in licensing and collaboration arrangements, holding investments in upstream cell therapy development through Legend Biotech.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The Group prioritizes innovation in antibody drug development, AI-assisted drug discovery, advanced therapeutics, and synthetic biology. It focuses on upgrading manufacturing platforms, expanding global manufacturing capacity, enhancing operational efficiency through automation and lean management, and strengthening commercial capabilities. The biologics CDMO segment emphasizes capability enhancement, quality management, data integrity, and information security. The Group also invests in new molecular entities and explores licensing and co-development models.
categories.revenue_model: GenScript generates revenue primarily through product sales and service fees from life-science research products, biologics development services, and industrial synthetic biology products. It also earns licensing and collaboration revenue, milestone payments, and royalties from intellectual property. The Group has rental income from investment properties and financial income from wealth management products. ProBio’s preferred shares and warrants contribute to financial gains or losses recognized at fair value.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: While specific competitors are not named, GenScript positions itself as a well-recognized biotechnology company with a comprehensive platform covering life-science research services, biologics CDMO, and synthetic biology products. It emphasizes cost-effective, high-quality, and fast-delivery services, with a strong global sales network and significant investments in cell therapy through Legend Biotech, enhancing its competitive edge in the biotech and biopharma industry.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the year ended 2024, GenScript reported revenue of approximately US$594.5 million, a 6.1% increase from 2023. The Group’s adjusted net profit from continuing operations was US$59.8 million, up 2.9%. The profit for the year was significantly impacted by a US$3.2 billion gain from the deconsolidation of Legend Biotech. The Group employs around 5,568 employees globally. Total assets were approximately US$5.28 billion with a gearing ratio of 18.1%, reflecting a solid financial position.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: GenScript emphasizes its proprietary gene synthesis technology, integrated end-to-end biologics development and manufacturing platform, and advanced synthetic biology capabilities. It offers superior quality, fast delivery, and cost-effective services with enhanced reliability and operational efficiency. The Group’s differentiated value proposition includes AI-driven innovation, robust global manufacturing footprint, premium technical support, and strategic collaborations to accelerate drug development and industrial applications, aiming to make people and nature healthier through biotechnology.
